2d33f12d0b3e.text: The card with the category Розовое (aratti-kaberne-po-belomu-1) is sold as vintage 2024. Its label exists in two versions: one prints ПОЛУСУХОЕ under the year 2024, and one prints no sugar level. The card with the category Красное (aratti-kaberne-po-belomu) shows the vintage 2023 on its catalogue label. A label without ПОЛУСУХОЕ does not identify either card. Use the year printed on the label: 2024 is the card with the category Розовое, 2023 is the card with the category Красное. ПОЛУСУХОЕ on the label is the card with the category Розовое.
